privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Timchenko Art collects when you use this site, how we use it, and what rights you have over your data.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: When you place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and shipping address. We do not store payment card details — these are handled exclusively by our payment partners (Stripe, NOWPayments) under their own security policies.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: We use your data to process your order, communicate about shipping status, and meet legal obligations, including tax record-keeping.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: We share only the minimum necessary data with payment providers and shipping carriers — solely to fulfill your order. We do not sell or share your data with advertising networks.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses functional cookies to remember your selected language, currency, and age confirmation. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under applicable data protection law (including GDPR for EU customers), you have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. Contact us at maryna.timchenko.art@gmail.com to exercise these rights.

artistIntro.heading: Maryna Timchenko: Art That Crosses Boundaries
paragraphs: Maryna Timchenko is a contemporary Ukrainian artist whose work moves beyond conventional ideas of beauty. She works in the erotic genre not for provocation, but as a way of exploring the deeper aspects of human nature, physicality, and emotional freedom.

Born in Ukraine, Maryna's path led from a classical art education to a distinctive personal style, where the body becomes language and emotion becomes color. Her work balances tenderness and passion, realism and abstraction, the private and the universal.

In 2022, the war in Ukraine forced her to leave her home country. She now lives in Germany, where she continues to create, drawing inspiration from her new surroundings while keeping a deep connection to Ukrainian culture and identity. Her art has become a way of preserving both herself and Ukraine's voice in the world.

features.label: Depth of subject
features.text: Every piece tells a story about human relationships, desire, and vulnerability.

features.label: Technique
features.text: Working across materials, from oil and watercolor to digital tools.

features.label: Contemporary voice
features.text: Art that speaks the language of today while holding on to timeless themes.

artistIntro.exhibitions: Maryna Timchenko's work has been shown in Ukraine, Germany, and the Netherlands, including international events such as Gogolfest (Kyiv), Shibari Fest Ukraine, and the A'DAM INT'L ART FAIR (Amsterdam). In 2024, she held a solo exhibition in Karlsruhe, Germany, at DCS Contemporary gallery.
